response.original_title: Power Pro Lucha: Aniversario ½: Big Trouble in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
response.overview: “Anything Goes Lucha Libre!”  Join Power Pro Lucha as we celebrate our 1-year anniversary the only way we know how—with a fun-filled Lucha fiesta in The City of Brotherly Love!  The first of our two-night Aniversario events, “Aniversario ½: Big Trouble in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania”, takes place Friday, April 3, kicking off The Prodigy Cup tournament with SIX Prodigy Cup Tournament Matches!—Four Quarter Finals and two Semi Finals!
